Content: This question has `bbtext(TWO)` parts. First, answer Part A. Then, answer Part B.
What is the main idea of the passage?

A.Choice: Two railroad companies competed to build the first transcontinental railroad.

B.Choice: Two railroad companies tried and failed to improve traveling by train across the transcontinental railroad.

C.Choice: Two railroad companies and the United States government built a transcontinental railroad for settlers moving west.

D.Choice: Two railroad companies worked together to build and benefit from a transcontinental railroad across the United States.

Content: Which detail from the passage supports the answer in Part A?

A.Choice: “... a railroad which connected the east coast with the west would make a good deal of money in trade.” (paragraph 1)

B.Choice: “In 1862, President Lincoln signed a bill which gave the railroad companies special land grants and government bonds to help pay for the job.” (paragraph 2)

C.Choice: “You can read in the descriptions entered in his journal that trains were still far from comfortable.” (paragraph 6)

D.Choice: “... we can look forward to using the rails again, and the development of a new and improved technology.” (paragraph 7)
